EvidenceVerify.//: F-17: periodically re-hash stored evidence and alarm when bytes drift from the recorded SHA-256. Off by default (a full re-hash is I/O-heavy); administered in-app. A pass also runs at startup.

Security.//: F-15: minutes of inactivity before a session is locked and the live circuit is torn down. 0 disables the app-level timeout. Administered in-app (Administration -> Settings -> Security); this is the fallback default.

Downloads.//: F-13: per-user token bucket on the evidence/report/export download endpoints. TokenLimit is the burst; TokensPerPeriod refill over PeriodSeconds sets the sustained rate. Over budget => immediate 429 + a SIEM event (5306). Server-side security config; restart to change.

Reporting.//: E-15: when true, a report must be approved by someone other than the analyst who generated it (two-person control). Administered in-app (Administration -> Settings -> Reporting); this is the fallback default.

Sla.//: E-16: per-severity response-time targets in hours (Detected -> Contained / Resolved). Blank/0 disables a severity's SLA. Administered in-app (Administration -> Settings -> Response SLA); these are the fallback defaults.

Severity.//: Admin-configurable display labels for the fixed severity levels (level/order/colour/SLA are unchanged; the stored value is always the canonical enum). Administered in-app (Administration -> Settings -> Severity labels); these are the fallback defaults.

Access.//: C-05: read/access logging. LogScope = Off | RestrictedOnly | All. CoalesceWindowMinutes folds repeat accesses of the same case/artifact by the same user into one session. Out of the tamper-evident chain; administered in-app (Administration -> Settings -> Access logging).

DataProtection.//: Empty in dev = framework default (per-user keyring). In prod set an absolute, ACL-restricted folder so the antiforgery/circuit keyring survives app-pool recycles; keys are encrypted at rest (DPAPI machine scope).

BackupStatus.//: H-04: path to the JSON status file the out-of-band backup/restore jobs write (see docs/OPERATIONS.md §1.3). Empty = not configured (dev). Thresholds drive the Diagnostics staleness verdict.

Email.//AssignmentNotifications: E-03b: email a person when they are assigned to a case. Admin-editable (Settings → Notifications). Off by default.

Notifications.//: E-03b: the periodic overdue after-action scan emails each item owner (else the case's incident commander) a reminder, once per item. Read-only over case data; sends only when Email:Enabled. Admin-editable (Settings → Notifications). Off by default.
Notifications.//DueSoonScan: E-03d: the periodic due-soon scan reminds each item owner (else the case's incident commander) once ahead of the deadline, when an item is due within LeadHours. Fires before the item lapses; the overdue scan still catches it if it does. Read-only; sends only when Email:Enabled. Admin-editable (Settings → Notifications). Off by default.

App.//: E-03b: absolute base URL of this deployment (e.g. https://casebook.corp.example), used to build direct links and the logo in notification emails. Admin-editable (Settings → Notifications). Blank = emails omit links and the hosted logo (they still render, branded, with a text wordmark).

Agenda.//: E-39: signing secret for the per-user agenda calendar (ICS) subscription feed (/agenda/feed.ics?token=...). Server-side only (a bearer secret, like the seal signing key) — NOT admin-editable. Blank = the subscribable feed is disabled (the authenticated one-shot download /agenda/agenda.ics still works). Set a long random value in appsettings.Production.json to enable Outlook subscriptions; rotating it invalidates every issued feed URL.

Siem.//: F-18: outbound security-event stream to SIEM. Transports (webhook JSON, syslog CEF) fan out from a bounded queue. Endpoints/secret stay in server-side config (not the in-app editable settings); status is shown read-only in Admin. Both transports disabled by default.

Webhook.//: JSON POST to the SIEM HTTP Collector. AuthHeader/AuthScheme match the collector (Authorization: Bearer, or x-api-key). Token may be a literal or, with Secrets:CyberArk enabled (F-19), a reference like '@cyberark:Safe=SIEM;Object=CaseBook-Webhook-Token' fetched from CyberArk CCP at runtime.

Syslog.//: CEF over syslog to an SIEM Broker VM / syslog collector. Protocol Udp (fire-and-forget) or Tcp. Facility 16 = local0.

Secrets.//: F-19: optional secret retrieval from CyberArk CCP. When CyberArk:Enabled=true, any config secret written as a reference ('@cyberark:Safe=<safe>;Object=<object>') is fetched from the Central Credential Provider at runtime instead of being stored here. Literal values are used as-is (opt-in per secret). CCP authenticates this app by client certificate and/or allow-listed machine/OS-user; no CCP password is stored. Disabled by default.
